title: The rules of Ghusl
intro: Ghusl is the religious bath that adults must take in certain states.

learn.html: Besides bathing regularly and making wudu, in certain cases a full religious bath is required before Salah. It is called ghusl. Ghusl is required of adult Muslims when they are in a state called janabah (major impurity).
Before bathing, we make the niyyah in the heart and may say it:

learn.label: The niyyah of ghusl
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ الْغُسْلَ لِرَفْعِ الْجَنَابَةِ وَلِرَفْعِ الْحَدَثِ تَقَرُّبًا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
learn.tr: Nawaytul-ghusla li-raf‘il-janaabati wa li-raf‘il-hadathi taqarruban ilallaahi ta‘aalaa.
learn.en: I intend to bathe to remove impurity and to come closer to Allah, the Most High.

items.label: 1. Gargarah – rinse the mouth and throat three times
2. Istinshaq – rinse the nose three times
3. Ghaslul-wujud – wash the whole body so no part stays dry

items: say A‘udhu billah, Bismillah and the niyyah
wash off any visible dirt first
start with the head, then the right side, then the left

learn.title: ⭐ Disliked in ghusl
learn.html: Wasting a lot of water, talking while bathing, and asking someone else to help if it isn’t necessary.

questions.q: How many fard does ghusl have?
Which part do we start washing with?
